blocks.content: CASSETTE DOOR AND FLUID SHIELD REPLACEMENT

blocks.section: CASSETTE DOOR AND FLUID SHIELD REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: Recommended tools for this procedure are a medium size flat-blade screwdriver and long needle nose pliers.

blocks.section: CASSETTE DOOR AND FLUID SHIELD REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: The replacement parts for this procedure are:

blocks.section: CASSETTE DOOR AND FLUID SHIELD REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: Assembly, Cassette Door

blocks.section: CASSETTE DOOR AND FLUID SHIELD REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: Assembly, Fluid Shield

blocks.section: CASSETTE DOOR AND FLUID SHIELD REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: Cap, Door Pivot

blocks.section: CASSETTE DOOR AND FLUID SHIELD REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: Screw, 4-40 x 3/8, Hex Head, Slotted, with Washer

blocks.section: CASSETTE DOOR AND FLUID SHIELD REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: To replace the cassette door and fluid shield, see Figure 7-15 and Figure 7-16 , then proceed as follows:

blocks.section: CASSETTE DOOR AND FLUID SHIELD REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: Turn off the infuser and disconnect the device from AC power.

blocks.section: CASSETTE DOOR AND FLUID SHIELD REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: Remove the battery as described in Section 7.2.4 .

blocks.section: CASSETTE DOOR AND FLUID SHIELD REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: Separate  the  front  enclosure,  rear  enclosure,  and  main  chassis  assembly as described in Section 7.2.8 .

blocks.section: CASSETTE DOOR AND FLUID SHIELD REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: Remove the mechanism assembly as described in Section 7.2.12.6 .

blocks.section: CASSETTE DOOR AND FLUID SHIELD REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: Using the flat blade screwdriver, remove the screw that secures the door pivot cap to the mechanism assembly. Disengage the cassette door from the opener handle assembly and remove the door.

blocks.section: CASSETTE DOOR AND FLUID SHIELD REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: Disengage the clips on the back side of the fluid shield that secure the upper portion of the shield to the mechanism assembly.

blocks.section: CASSETTE DOOR AND FLUID SHIELD REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: Lift the locking pins to release the fluid shield/driver flex connector, and disconnect the flex connector from the driver PWA.

blocks.section: CASSETTE DOOR AND FLUID SHIELD REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: Pull the shield away from the top of the mechanism assembly at an approximate 15-degree angle. Pull the shield up and away, clearing the mechanism assembly pins and plunger.

blocks.section: CASSETTE DOOR AND FLUID SHIELD REPLACEMENT
CASSETTE DOOR AND FLUID SHIELD REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: Note: Prior to fluid shield replacement, align the mechanism assembly pins.

blocks.section: CASSETTE DOOR AND FLUID SHIELD REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: Install the replacement fluid shield in the exact reverse order of removal.

blocks.section: CASSETTE DOOR AND FLUID SHIELD REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: Install the replacement cassette door in the exact reverse order of removal.

blocks.section: CASSETTE DOOR AND FLUID SHIELD REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: Replace the mechanism assembly in the exact reverse order of removal.

blocks.section: CASSETTE DOOR AND FLUID SHIELD REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: Join the front enclosure, rear enclosure, and main chassis assembly in the exact reverse order of separation.

blocks.section: CASSETTE DOOR AND FLUID SHIELD REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: Reinstall the battery and connect the device to AC power.

blocks.section: CASSETTE DOOR AND FLUID SHIELD REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: To  verify  successful  cassette  door  and  fluid  shield  replacement,  perform  the  PVT in Section 5.2 .
